description: Pick random words that can follow the previous word (or start with a given kana), excluding words already used and, by default, words ending in ん. pool "everyday" (default) uses hand-picked everyday words, "common" adds common dictionary words, "all" uses the whole dictionary.

allow_n.description: Include words ending in ん (they lose).

exclude.description: Words already used in this game.

genre.description: Theme for 食べ物しりとり etc. (everyday words only).

start_char.description: Or: one kana to start with, e.g. "り".

name: suggest_next
title: Suggest next words
